# Workhorse Insurance

## About
Workhorse Insurance (workhorseinsurance.com) is a specialty insurance agency for commercial work-truck and fleet operators — service trucks, utility and box trucks, contractor work trucks, and small commercial fleets. We place coverage through specialty commercial auto and fleet carriers. A division of Contractors Choice Agency, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states since 2005.

## Why Work-Truck Businesses Need Specialty Coverage
Personal auto policies exclude regular business use and company-titled vehicles, and can deny claims after a business-use accident. Work trucks and fleets need commercial coverage that addresses the road, the load, and the work — plus the hidden gap when employees drive personal or rented vehicles for the business.

## Services
- Commercial Auto Insurance: Liability and on-road coverage for your trucks and drivers; the core fleet policy.
- Hired & Non-Owned Auto (HNOA): Liability when employees drive personal or rented vehicles for business — a commonly missed gap.
- General Liability Insurance: Third-party bodily injury and property damage from your operations and completed work.
- Motor Truck Cargo Insurance: Protects the materials, goods, and equipment you haul against loss or damage in transit.
- Physical Damage Insurance: Collision and comprehensive coverage for your own trucks — repairs and replacement after a loss.
- Tools & Equipment Insurance: Inland marine coverage for tools and equipment in your trucks, on the job and in transit.
- Workers Compensation Insurance: Medical and wage-replacement benefits for injured drivers and crew.

## Target Audience
Commercial work-truck operators, service-truck businesses, utility and box-truck operators, contractor fleets, delivery and hauling businesses, and small-to-midsize commercial fleets.
